pages.text: About 11 blocks long, and every body segment can be hit. It bites, and it $(thing)charges$(): if it hits a wall it's stunned, so stand in front of one and step aside. It $(thing)burrows$() (sand puffs show where it'll come up) and sweeps its tail at anyone beside or behind it.
pages.title: Dozen-legged Wrath

pages.text: Below 40% health it speeds up and charges twice in a row.
16 $(item)Terror Legs$() and a $(item)Venomjaw$(), always. They make the $(l:gear/weapons)Quadblade of the Sands$(/l) and the $(l:gear/armour)Ancientstone$(/l) armour.
pages.title: Drops
